steps.description: Parse input data and build data structures for jobs, operations, machines, downtimes and policy
Determine precedence-aware repair order: sort operations by (index, baseline start, base index)

suggestions: Sort operations by (job_index, baseline_start, op_index) to establish a deterministic precedence-aware repair order.

steps.description: Implement overlap detection using half-open intervals [s,e)

failure_patterns.reason: ⚠️ Use half-open intervals [s,e). Correct: s < b and a < e. Using <= incorrectly flags adjacent non-overlapping intervals.

suggestions: For intervals [a,b) and [s,e): overlap = s < b and a < e. Never use <= — adjacent intervals must NOT overlap.

steps.description: Implement has_conflict checking both machine timeline and downtime intervals
Implement earliest_feasible_time with incremental forward scan (t += 1) from anchor

failure_patterns.reason: ⚠️ Must scan forward incrementally (t += 1). Jumping to gaps or using binary search misses the true earliest feasible slot.

suggestions: Scan: t = anchor; while has_conflict(machine, t, t + duration): t += 1 — increment by 1 to guarantee the earliest slot.

steps.description: Repair operations in order; append ALL operations (including frozen) to machine_intervals

failure_patterns.reason: ❌ CRITICAL: Frozen operations MUST still be appended to machine_intervals. Skipping them allows later operations to incorrectly overlap their time slots.

suggestions: Always call machine_intervals[m].append((start, end)) for every operation, including frozen ones.
warnings: Frozen operations cannot be moved, but they still occupy machine time — always record them.
